the analysis of a single cell in the developing nervous system, and the use of time-lapse video to acquire a detailed view of the normal development of the nervous system over time.
identifying the mechanisms by which a neuron can recognize a target, such as a midline, and respond appropriately by changing its morphology, rate of translocation and/or direction of migration.

the growth cone is capable of responding to the midline with several distinct activities, including filopodial retraction and filopodial dilation.
